❌ ③ changed — tiny — extinct (B 반대: 엄청난→아주 작은)

questions.passage: Mobile communications have changed the way we interact with our computers and, as more time is spent on mobile devices, emoticon use has followed. Cellular phones, smartphones, tablets, and similar technologies have penetrated the world at an enormous rate and non-voice communications have become the norm rather than the rule. In 2013, the number of mobile subscriptions almost equaled the estimated number of individuals that made up __________ in the same year. Users of these technologies have posted, pinned, tweeted, sent and/or received billions of electronic messages through public or private (text messages, emails, etc.) means. These communications media have become so prolific, researchers have worried that face-to-face communications could become extinct.
questions.stem: 다음 글의 빈칸에 들어갈 말로 가장 적절한 것은?

det.korean: 같은 해 전 세계 인구(the global population)를 구성한 개인의 수.
det.analysis:
❌ ① the local community — 지역 공동체 (전 세계 규모와 어긋남)
✅ ② the global population — 전 세계 인구 ←정답
❌ ③ the daily routine — 일상 (개인 수 맥락과 무관)
❌ ④ the annual budget — 연간 예산 (인구가 아님)
det.tip: the number of individuals that made up ____(개인들이 구성한 대상) → 전 세계 인구

questions.passage: Mobile communications have changed the way we interact with our computers and, as more time is spent on mobile devices, emoticon use has followed. Cellular phones, smartphones, tablets, and similar technologies have penetrated the world at an enormous rate and non-voice communications have become the norm rather than the rule. In 2013, the number of mobile subscriptions almost equaled the estimated number of individuals that made up the global population in the same year. Users of these technologies have posted, pinned, tweeted, sent and/or received billions of electronic messages through public or private (text messages, emails, etc.) means. These communications media have become so prolific, researchers have worried that __________ could become extinct.
questions.stem: 다음 글의 빈칸에 들어갈 말로 가장 적절한 것은?

det.korean: 연구자들은 대면 소통(face-to-face communications)이 사라질 수 있다고 걱정한다.
det.analysis:
❌ ① online advertising — 온라인 광고 (사라짐 걱정의 대상이 아님)
❌ ② written grammar — 문법 (문맥과 무관)
✅ ③ face-to-face communications — 대면 소통 ←정답
❌ ④ mobile batteries — 휴대폰 배터리 (문맥과 무관)
det.tip: 비음성·전자 소통이 늘어 '대면 소통'이 사라질까 걱정하는 흐름
